basis: User constraints plus immutable d573 source202 requirements and append-only d580 source203 requirements. Actual right boundary consumed only from hash-verified d575.

judgment_policy.PASS: Every applicable source-coverage, physics, bilingual-correspondence and teaching-role obligation has direct localized evidence. Mapping is checked, never accepted as its own proof.
judgment_policy.FAIL: A definite localized omission, false physics, mismatched meaning, source/formula mutation, invented measurement or new exercise is present.
judgment_policy.HOLD: A localized uncertainty, unavailable binding, unverifiable premise or ambiguous meaning remains. Do not infer PASS.
judgment_policy.gate_aggregation: FAIL if any definite blocker; otherwise HOLD if any unresolved blocker; otherwise PASS for the stated text-only scope.
judgment_policy.first_attempt_retention: Record the first FAIL/HOLD and its localized ID. No author repairs, native reruns, silent criteria changes or replacement review attempt.
judgment_policy.figure_limit: Assess figure IDs, caption text, prose relations and metadata binding only. No judgment of pixels, SVG fidelity, geometry, marker fill, arrows, exact coordinates, scale, dimensions or rendered display.
judgment_policy.source_limit: Consume existing SOURCE202203 acceptance and actual SOURCE204 boundary. Do not sign whole-source acceptance or full-card approval.

global_checks.criterion: Verify supplied d582 report and author-freeze hashes, every freeze file's full SHA-256, byte size and declared mode, all external source bindings, and absence of unlisted author files before semantic candidate review.
